title: Circle Membership Standing and the Share of a Northbeam Returns and Restocking Fee It Relieves
content:
The membership's standing fixes the share. Where the membership stands active and its dues carry nothing outstanding, the tier's published restocking fee waiver share is the share. Where the membership stands active and part of its dues stands unpaid, half the tier's published share is the share. In any other case there is no share and no relief is given.

## What is read

The membership read is the one standing on the customer's profile on Northbeam Circle Membership: whether it stands active, the restocking fee waiver share its tier publishes, and whether any part of its dues stands unpaid. The share this fixes is the share taken against the Northbeam Returns and Restocking fee still standing.

| The membership | Its dues | The share |
| --- | --- | --- |
| active | nothing outstanding | the restocking fee waiver share its tier publishes |
| active | part of them unpaid | half the share its tier publishes |
| not active | whatever they stand at | no share at all, and no relief is given |

## Cases on hypothetical inputs

*A membership standing active whose tier publishes a restocking fee waiver share of 30 per cent, dues carrying nothing outstanding.* The share is 30 per cent.

*The same membership with 18.00 USD of dues unpaid.* Part of the dues stands unpaid, so the share is half of 30 per cent, that is 15 per cent.

*A membership that has lapsed, whose tier publishes 30 per cent, dues carrying nothing outstanding.* It does not stand active. There is no share at all, and no relief is given.

*A membership standing active whose tier publishes no waiver share at all, dues carrying nothing outstanding.* The share its tier publishes is nothing, so the share is nothing.
